pages.title: The Air Is Strong - Punish It Anyway
pages.text: EFZ has minimal crossup protection and strong air movement, so opponents WILL jump at you. The answer is a dedicated anti-air: a move whose hitbox and invulnerability are built to win that exchange.

pages.title: Why the Dragon Punch
pages.text: Nayuki's {input:623B} has HIGH-area invulnerability from frame 1 - the jump-in simply cannot touch her upper body while it starts. That is what makes a dragon punch the cleanest anti-air answer: it wins even when the jump-in is already on top of you.

pages.title: The Drill
pages.text: Misaki keeps jumping in. Catch her out of the air with {input:623B} or {input:623C} while she is still airborne. If you are trading or losing, you are pressing too late - the goal is to hit her BEFORE her attack comes down.

tasks.label: Anti-air the first jump-in
tasks.prompt: Hit Misaki out of the air - the attack must connect while she is airborne.

feedback.success: Clean anti-air - she never got to land her attack.
feedback.failure: Too late: she reached you or landed first. Start your attack while she is still rising or at the top of her arc.

tasks.label: Anti-air the second jump-in
tasks.prompt: Again - catch her in the air before the jump attack comes down.

feedback.failure: The hit has to land while she is airborne - commit a little earlier.

tasks.label: Anti-air the third jump-in
tasks.prompt: One more - make stopping the jump-in feel automatic.

feedback.success: Three in a row - the air is yours.
feedback.failure: Reset and watch the jump start; that is your cue to attack.

tasks.label: React to one final jump-in with your anti-air
tasks.prompt: One more time - stop the jump-in clean with {input:623B} or {input:623C} while the dummy is still airborne.

feedback.success: Clean interception - you recognized and stopped the jump-in again.
feedback.failure: Catch her while she is still airborne.

cue.text: Misaki is jumping in - hit her out of the air.
Another jump-in - meet her before it lands.
She keeps coming - anti-air on reaction.
Last one - stop the jump-in cleanly.
